source.title: Recurrent network model for learning goal-directed sequences through reverse replay.

confidence_rationale: A mechanistic CA3 model showing reverse replay, which occurs preferentially at REWARDED locations, selectively strengthens the goal-directed (forward) synaptic pathway -- i.e. reward-anchored replay GATES which downstream pathway is updated. This is the closest biological analog to 'replay gates which experiences update downstream representations', the core of MECH-443. Model rather than recording, and the write target is a synaptic pathway not a rule-arbitration weight, hence moderate confidence.
failure_signatures: It is a synaptic-plasticity model in CA3, not a recording; the 'write' is potentiation of a place-cell pathway, an analog of (not identical to) a rule-arbitration weight update.

Selectivity arises from short-term depression / afterdepolarization interacting with symmetric STDP -- a specific cellular mechanism with no direct REE counterpart, so the WHY of the gating does not transfer even though the WHAT does.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Reverse replay, which is frequent at rewarded locations, biases synaptic transmission so that it selectively strengthens the forward (start-to-goal) pathway rather than both directions -- providing a mechanism by which reward-anchored replay determines which pathway is updated.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-443: replay does not just decide whether to write, it gates WHICH downstream pathway the write strengthens, and it does so anchored to reward/goal relevance -- a graded, content-selective write rather than MECH-319's all-or-nothing mode gate.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The write target is a CA3 place-cell synaptic pathway, not REE's rule-arbitration weight; the gating mechanism (short-term depression + symmetric STDP) is cellular and has no REE counterpart, so only the functional pattern (reward-anchored replay selects the update target) transfers.
mapping.source_context: Biophysically-constrained recurrent CA3 network model; W-maze and 2D open-field goal-directed navigation.

confidence_components.notes: Directly addresses the write-GATING step that the recording papers leave inferred, but it is a model and the substrate is synaptic, not rule-arbitration.
